none: PAS FindID 1000460: Lin-DB188F: Roman nummus of Crispus

A complete and worn, copper-alloy Roman nummus of Crispus c.317-318 AD. Mint of Trier. Officina number A (Alpha). Reece Period 16. As RIC 7 no. 170. Obverse description: Laureate & draped bust facing right. Obverse inscription: FL.IVL.CRISPVS.NOB.CAES. Reverse description: Prince in military dress standing right holding transverse spear and globe. Reverse inscription: PRINCIPI IVVENTVTIS. Reverse mint mark: F T // ATR. Diameter: 19.69 mm; Thickness: 1.58 mm; Weight: 2.72g
